purpose: renderer-agnostic scene of the Republic's coding history + corrections; render with ANY generator to recreate the architecture at fraction of original cost
provenance: OUR OWN history (self-steal), NOT frontier output

scene.center: route ALL work through the sovereign architecture (REST routes, queue, drainer, governor/autorun loop, ghost, overseer) — NEVER ad-hoc terminal commands; async-able work goes to the queue, deterministic work to non-prompting tools; system-imperative local ops get a BUILT path, not a hand-run.
the $0 doctrine: JSONL + sha256 content-addressing + file reads; modules avoid LLM calls; deterministic modules run for free and are the load-bearing substrate under the stochastic swarm.
memory is a chain of content-addressed knots (filename=address); a tip root points at the present; the surface is a viewer, the artifact is truth.

RIBs are renderer-agnostic scenes: declare a constellation of slots in stochastic space and let ANY generator (frontier, k8s swarm, local model) fill it; steering is the constraint satisfier (attractors pull wanted data, repellors push already-covered).

compare frontier answers THROUGH INVARIANTS: statements recurring across >=2 independent witnesses = the Roshomon core (convergent truth); unique statements = divergent perspective; the core folds as doctrine.
the frontier AUTHORES scenes (RIBs); OUR k8s swarm RENDERS them. We take the invariants and our own cheap compute does the work. Never ask the frontier to execute.

memlang is a compact binary trigger token anchored to shared verkle state; every opcode maps to a FORMAL MEMORY CONTRACT (a real kind/surface/schema/rw), so a token's grounding is provable, not handwaved.

HONESTY EVERYWHERE: no artifact may claim 'grok'/'frontier' provenance unless real output was captured; independent witnesses over single-oracle verification; the ponytail grounding audit challenges, not trusts; there is no 'steal' without a real source.
replicas:1 DELIBERATE; ONE controller owns the always-on loop (never two — the window-storm/double-drain fix).

the tool manifest auto-discovers every mag/*.py, reads SCHEMA/purpose/CLI/REST from the module's own source, and emits memory/tool_manifest.json + TOOLS.md — full access to every tool, populating in VS Code.

scene.detail: swarm 8-fail bug: run_py double-prepended the interpreter (python python main.py); fixed by run_headless(cmd). Guardrail: never double-wrap the interpreter.

dashboard crash: local host ran BOTH mag_launch and process_supervisor driving always-on loops = double-supervision. Guardrail: one controller owns the loop; host the dashboard in-cluster, not on the local machine.
grok:True in artifacts was only the REQUEST flag, not evidence of output. Guardrail: grok_captured = real output only; provenance_note when it didn't arrive.
container infinite restart: 'power off' exited 0, outer restart policy respawned forever. Guardrail: hold-alive (idle) instead of exit on power-off.
225 near-dup doctrine pairs were mostly template similarity; consolidated into families. Guardrail: consolidate templates, don't pile copies.
